text:
priya: quick heads-up — we're proposing an audit event schema update next week. add two fields: `actor_ip` and `resource_fqdn`. deprecate `user_agent` (customers asked). goal: non-breaking for most consumers but introduce `schema_version` and an opt-in v2 preview for customers. need alignment on versioning, validators, and KMS implications. :eyes:

jordan: +1. do we intend a semantic major bump (v1 -> v2) or a minor? i vote explicit `schema_version: "audit.v2"` in the root of the event so consumers can branch easily.

maria: any examples of the event shapes? also concerned about logs pipelines that assume `user_agent` exists. will we dual-write?

priya: example shapes below — v1 (current) and v2 (proposal). we'll publish JSON Schema and an automated validator. customers can run validator locally before cutover.

priya: ```json
// v1
{
  "schema_version": "audit.v1",
  "timestamp": "2026-10-02T15:12:00Z",
  "actor": { "id": "u_123", "type": "user" },
  "action": "model.deploy",
  "resource": { "id": "r_456", "type": "model" },
  "user_agent": "curl/7.82"
}

// v2 (proposal)
{
  "schema_version": "audit.v2",
  "timestamp": "2026-10-02T15:12:00Z",
  "actor": { "id": "u_123", "type": "user", "actor_ip_encrypted": "<kms-wrapped>" },
  "action": "model.deploy",
  "resource": { "id": "r_456", "type": "model", "resource_fqdn": "models.prod.redwood.ai" }
}
```

leo: KMS question — if we add `actor_ip_encrypted` (recommended for PII), make sure we store the KMS key ARN in the validator metadata. key rotation must preserve ability to decrypt historical events used for incident triage. recommend envelope encryption with key IDs included on each event.

sam: for consumer compatibility, we should: 1) include `schema_version`, 2) publish both v1 and v2 JSON Schemas, 3) run dual-delivery to internal subsystems for 2 weeks (incoming events tagged v2 and v1 for parity checks), 4) offer a migration window with feature flag gating.

maria: +1 to dual-delivery for internal teams. for external customers, can we provide a preview feed (signed) so customers can validate mapping in their pipelines? maybe via a temporary topic in the customer sandbox org.

priya: yes on preview feed. we can add a `events-preview` endpoint (read-only) that returns sample v2 events for their org. will coordinate with API and infra.

security-bot: vuln-triage: CVE-2026-0421 affects older audit parsers that expect `user_agent` as string. tagging this rollout as possible mitigation surface. please schedule parser updates before cutover.

leo: impact on incident response playbooks — many runbook steps parse `user_agent` and IP. update runbooks to use `actor_ip_encrypted` (decrypt step) or fallback to legacy `user_agent` mapping. note: decrypt requires KMS IAM permission; oncall needs temporary decrypt role.

priya: action items:
- priya: publish v2 JSON Schema + migration guide by 2026-10-05
- jordan: add `schema_version` header support to event router by 2026-10-07
- sam: dual-delivery plan (internal) + telemetry for parity checks by 2026-10-09
- leo: KMS envelope encryption + key rotation doc by 2026-10-06
- maria: coordinate preview feed + customer comms draft by 2026-10-08
- #security-oncall: update runbooks and grant decrypt role before cutover

jordan: I'll add lightweight compatibility tests to our CI that assert parsers tolerate missing `user_agent` and prefer `actor_ip_encrypted` when present. will post PR today.

sam: question about storage/export: do we want to keep v1 events in the same S3 bucket or move to `s3://redwood-audit/v1/` and `.../v2/`? segregation helps lifecycle and retention differences.

priya: prefer segregated prefixes (v1/v2) to simplify retention and access controls. update the ingestion lambda to tag accordingly.

maria: small ask — can we add a machine-readable changelog and migration checklist in the docs site so partners can programmatically detect required changes?

priya: yes, I'll add `/docs/audit/schema/changelog.json` and a short human FAQ.

leo: one more: if customers have RBAC filters that rely on `resource` shape, ensure `resource_fqdn` is included in the stable resource object (not nested under extras) so policy engines don't break.

priya: good call. keep `resource_fqdn` at `resource.resource_fqdn`.

security-bot: deploy-batch: scheduled dry-run of v2 events to internal consumers: 2026-10-10T02:00:00Z -> 2026-10-10T06:00:00Z. monitoring hooks enabled.

priya: thanks all. I'll open the RFC doc and the validator repo PR after stand. ping me for follow-ups or to be added to the preview org. :thumbsup:
